# Turkey: joining sides, the Kuwait game, the Syrian war.

# TUR scope.
wif_tur_join_allies = {
	if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { any_country = { is_faction_leader = yes OR = { tag = ENG tag = USA } } }
		random_country = { limit = { is_faction_leader = yes OR = { tag = ENG tag = USA } } add_to_faction = ROOT }
	}
	if = { limit = { country_exists = GER NOT = { has_war_with = GER } } declare_war_on = { target = GER type = annex_everything } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = JAP NOT = { has_war_with = JAP } } declare_war_on = { target = JAP type = annex_everything } }
}
wif_tur_join_axis = {
	if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = GER GER = { is_faction_leader = yes } }
		GER = { add_to_faction = ROOT }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = ITA ITA = { is_faction_leader = yes } }
		ITA = { add_to_faction = ROOT }
	}
}
wif_tur_join_rome = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = ITA ITA = { is_faction_leader = yes } NOT = { is_in_faction_with = ITA } }
		if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
		ITA = { add_to_faction = ROOT }
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the Kuwait game
# TUR scope. Adds temp variables wif_tur_kw_di (Influence) and wif_tur_kw_du (Unrest), with
# the focus multipliers (scripted effects take no parameters).
wif_tur_kw_add = {
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_tur_kw_court check_variable = { wif_tur_kw_di > 0 } } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_tur_kw_di = 1.25 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_tur_kw_majlis check_variable = { wif_tur_kw_du > 0 } } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_tur_kw_du = 1.25 } }
	add_to_variable = { wif_tur_kw_inf = wif_tur_kw_di }
	add_to_variable = { wif_tur_kw_unrest = wif_tur_kw_du }
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_tur_kw_inf min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_tur_kw_unrest min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# TUR scope: an agent caught.
wif_tur_kw_caught = {
	set_temp_variable = { wif_tur_kw_di = -10 }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_tur_kw_du = 0 }
	wif_tur_kw_add = yes
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = KUW KUW = { is_subject = yes } }
		KUW = { OVERLORD = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = wif_tur_op_m25 } } }
	}
	country_event = { id = wif_tur.42 }
}

# TUR scope, monthly while the game is on: the garrison answers.
wif_tur_kw_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_tur_kw_game NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_tur_kw_over } country_exists = KUW }
		country_event = { id = wif_tur.41 days = 1 }
	}
}

# TUR scope: The Kuwait Crisis.
wif_tur_kw_crisis = {
	set_country_flag = wif_tur_kw_over
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_tur_kw_inf > 59.9 } check_variable = { wif_tur_kw_unrest > 59.9 } }
		# The best result: a rising that invites us in.
		KUW = { if = { limit = { is_subject = yes } OVERLORD = { end_puppet = KUW } } }
		puppet = KUW
		add_resource = { type = oil amount = 4 state = 656 }
		news_event = { id = wif_tur.45 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_tur_kw_inf > 74.9 } }
		# The Sheikh asks for Turkish protection.
		KUW = { if = { limit = { is_subject = yes } OVERLORD = { end_puppet = KUW } } }
		puppet = KUW
		news_event = { id = wif_tur.43 days = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		# Kuwait rises and throws out the garrison - and we may march in.
		KUW = { if = { limit = { is_subject = yes } OVERLORD = { end_puppet = KUW } } }
		create_wargoal = { type = annex_everything target = KUW }
		news_event = { id = wif_tur.44 days = 1 }
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Syria
# TUR scope: March into Syria.
wif_tur_march_into_syria = {
	set_global_flag = wif_tur_syrian_war
	save_event_target_as = wif_tur_invader
	# Syria independent, with Lebanon.
	if = { limit = { country_exists = SYR SYR = { is_subject_of = VIC } } VIC = { end_puppet = SYR } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = LEB LEB = { is_subject_of = VIC } } VIC = { end_puppet = LEB } }
	every_state = {
		limit = { OR = { state = 554 state = 677 state = 680 state = 553 } OR = { is_owned_by = VIC is_owned_by = LEB is_owned_by = SYR } }
		transfer_state_to = SYR
	}
	# Every French division stationed there becomes Syrian (counted, removed, raised again).
	set_variable = { wif_tur_fr_div = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = { OR = { state = 554 state = 677 state = 680 state = 553 } }
		every_state_division = {
			event_target:wif_tur_invader = { add_to_variable = { wif_tur_fr_div = 1 } }
			destroy_unit = yes
		}
	}
	SYR = {
		set_country_flag = wif_tur_syrian_defender
		add_ideas = wif_splinter_no_factions
		if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Armee du Levant" } } division_template = { name = "Armee du Levant" regiments = { infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 } infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 } infantry = { x = 0 y = 2 } infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 } infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 } infantry = { x = 1 y = 2 } } } }
	}
	add_to_variable = { wif_tur_fr_div = 2 }		# at least the Syrian levies
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_tur_fr_div > 0 } }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_tur_fr_div = 1 }
		554 = { create_unit = { division = "division_template = \"Armee du Levant\" start_experience_factor = 0.2 start_equipment_factor = 1.0" owner = SYR count = 1 } }
	}
	# 10% of Vichy's stockpile.
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = VIC }
		VIC = {
			transfer_units_fraction = {
				target = SYR
				size = 0
				army_ratio = 0
				navy_ratio = 0
				air_ratio = 0
				stockpile_ratio = 0.1
				keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	# The limited war: 45 days.
	declare_war_on = { target = SYR type = annex_everything }
	add_timed_idea = { idea = wif_tur_syrian_war_idea days = 45 }
	country_event = { id = wif_tur.35 days = 45 }
	news_event = { id = wif_tur.33 days = 1 }
}

# on_capitulation_immediate: ROOT capitulated, FROM the winner.
wif_tur_on_capitulation = {
	if = {
		limit = { tag = SYR has_country_flag = wif_tur_syrian_defender FROM = { tag = TUR } has_global_flag = wif_tur_syrian_war }
		clr_global_flag = wif_tur_syrian_war
		TUR = {
			annex_country = { target = SYR transfer_troops = yes }
			677 = { add_core_of = TUR }
			680 = { add_core_of = TUR }
			news_event = { id = wif_tur.36 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}

		limit = { has_government = democratic }
		create_country_leader = { name = "wif_tur_assembly" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/Portrait_wif_assembly.png" expire = "1965.1.1" ideology = conservatism traits = { } }

		limit = { has_government = fascism }
		create_country_leader = { name = "wif_tur_assembly" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/Portrait_wif_assembly.png" expire = "1965.1.1" ideology = fascism_ideology traits = { } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_government = communism }
		create_country_leader = { name = "wif_tur_assembly" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/Portrait_wif_assembly.png" expire = "1965.1.1" ideology = marxism traits = { } }
	}
	else = {
		create_country_leader = { name = "wif_tur_assembly" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/Portrait_wif_assembly.png" expire = "1965.1.1" ideology = despotism traits = { } }
	}
}

# TUR scope, daily: once Ataturk is dead (WiF's wif_tur.1, or vanilla's turkey.1 without the DLC,
# which promotes Inonu at once), the Assembly takes over - unless Milli Sef is already done.
wif_tur_daily = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_tur_assembly_leads }
			NOT = { has_completed_focus = wif_tur_milli_sef }
			OR = {
				has_global_flag = wif_tur_ataturk_dead
				AND = { date > 1938.11.1 NOT = { has_country_leader = { character = TUR_mustafa_kemal_ataturk ruling_only = yes } } }
			}
		}
		wif_tur_assembly_leads = yes
	}
}

# TUR scope: Milli Sef - Inonu replaces the Assembly.
wif_tur_inonu_takes_over = {
	clr_country_flag = wif_tur_assembly_leads
	set_country_flag = wif_tur_assembly_leads		# never again
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_character = TUR_ismet_inonu } NOT = { any_country = { has_character = TUR_ismet_inonu } } }
		recruit_character = TUR_ismet_inonu
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character = TUR_ismet_inonu }
		promote_character = TUR_ismet_inonu
	}
}
